name: Yorgo
description: A street urchin leader who becomes Jared's ally.

description_citations.text: "The Shadow Mage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: General Yorgo defends the city and its residents from the worst of the Planeswalker War.
timeline.quote: desperately defended the city and its residents from the worst of the Planeswalker War

citation.text: "Arathoxia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jared Carthalion and Yorgo infiltrate Melmereth and Jared summons a Shivan Dragon, destroying it.
timeline.quote: Jared summoned a Shivan Dragon , resulting in the fortress's destruction

citation.text: "Stonehaven", section "Stonehaven locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jared steals the Black Lotus, learns of his mother, and with Liana escapes the baths; Ravidel beats Jared back until Liana reveals three Moxes and Ravidel leaves.
timeline.quote: Liana reveals she has three Moxes , giving her the upper hand in a duel.

citation.text: "The Shadow Mage", section "Volume 2: Desolate Angel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yorgo brings the captured sultan to Jared and hands him a fellwar stone and scroll to enter Castle Melmereth.
timeline.quote: Yorgo hands Jared a fellwar stone and a spell scroll he can use to enter Castle Melmereth

citation.text: "The Shadow Mage", section "Volume 4: First Duel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Narok kills Nikko and Jared annihilates Narok, then crushes the Black Lotus to summon a Shivan Dragon that destroys the castle; Ezer dies, and the castle explodes from Liana's sorcery.
timeline.quote: Jared crushes the Black Lotus and summons a Shivan Dragon

citation.text: "The Shadow Mage", section "Volume 4: First Duel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Elder Druid of Corondor finds Jared with Yorgo's help and warns of the coming war while Jared tends to Kristina as she gives birth to Justina.
timeline.quote: The Elder Druid, revealing that he bore the crescent-moon Mark of the Elder Druid, warned of the coming war and the necessity of preparation.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Elder Druid finds Jared with Yorgo's help as Kristina gives birth to Justina, and announces he has come to prepare others for war.
timeline.quote: Kristina gives birth to a daughter, and they name her Justina .
